module: 'Tags' tab of the sites editor (Location Tags, Zone Tags, Parking Spot Tags depending on the key). The module returns a class constructor C. It lists all the tags present in sites[key] and, for the chosen tag, displays two columns (elements that have it / that do not) with buttons to move one or all elements from one side to the other, which calls customFields:addTag / removeTag. Elements are highlighted in the world on hover.
notes: The '>' button removes the tag from all the elements that have it; '<' adds it to all the others.

C.desc: Object returned by the constructor. Fields: sitesEditor, key, sites, tag, tags, sortedTags, hasTag, noTag.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active: rereads and sorts all the tags of the elements.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left; does nothing.

draw.desc: Draws the tab (calls drawGeneralInfo). Called with mouseInfo by sitesEditor but the method ignores it.

selectTag.desc: Chooses a tag and splits the elements into hasTag and noTag.

drawGeneralInfo.desc: Draws the tag list and the two management columns of the chosen tag.
